#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Task-local helper: prepend a cover page to report.pdf.

Creates a letter-size cover page with the exact title "Annual Financial
Report" and the operator runtime current date, then prepends it to the
existing report.pdf (writing report.pdf in place via an atomic replace).
Only report.pdf is touched; no network or package installs.
"""

import datetime
import io
import os
import sys

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

INPUT_PDF = "report.pdf"
TEMP_PDF = "report_with_cover.tmp.pdf"
TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"


def build_cover_pdf_bytes() -> bytes:
    """Return a one-page letter-size PDF with the title and current date."""
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    c = canvas.Canvas(buf, pagesize=letter)
    width, height = letter

    today = datetime.date.today()
    date_str = today.strftime("%B %d, %Y")

    # Title, centered horizontally and vertically.
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 30)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2.0, height / 2.0 + 20, TITLE)

    # Date underneath the title.
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 18)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2.0, height / 2.0 - 30, date_str)

    # Decorative rule above and below.
    c.setLineWidth(1.5)
    c.line(width / 2.0 - 150, height / 2.0 + 55, width / 2.0 + 150, height / 2.0 + 55)
    c.line(width / 2.0 - 150, height / 2.0 - 60, width / 2.0 + 150, height / 2.0 - 60)

    c.showPage()
    c.save()
    return buf.getvalue()


def main() -> None:
    if not os.path.exists(INPUT_PDF):
        print(f"FAILURE: {INPUT_PDF} not found in {os.getcwd()}")
        sys.exit(1)

    reader = PdfReader(INPUT_PDF)
    original_count = len(reader.pages)
    print(f"Read {INPUT_PDF}: {original_count} page(s)")

    cover_bytes = build_cover_pdf_bytes()
    cover_reader = PdfReader(io.BytesIO(cover_bytes))
    cover_text = cover_reader.pages[0].extract_text()
    print(f"Cover page text extracted for validation: {cover_text!r}")

    writer = PdfWriter()
    writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])  # cover page first
    for page in reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    with open(TEMP_PDF, "wb") as f:
        writer.write(f)

    os.replace(TEMP_PDF, INPUT_PDF)  # atomically replace report.pdf
    print(f"Wrote {INPUT_PDF} with cover page prepended")

    # Validation pass: reopen and verify.
    check_reader = PdfReader(INPUT_PDF)
    new_count = len(check_reader.pages)
    first_text = check_reader.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
    print(f"Validation: {INPUT_PDF} now has {new_count} page(s) (was {original_count})")

    ok = True
    if new_count != original_count + 1:
        print("FAILURE: page count did not increase by exactly one")
        ok = False
    if TITLE not in first_text:
        print("FAILURE: title not found on cover page")
        ok = False
    if date_str := datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y"):
        if date_str not in first_text:
            print("FAILURE: current date not found on cover page")
            ok = False
    if ok:
        print(f"SUCCESS: cover page added with title {TITLE!r} and date {datetime.date.today().strftime('%B %d, %Y')}")
    else:
        sys.exit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Task-local helper: prepend a cover page to report.pdf.

The cover page contains the exact title "Annual Financial Report" and the
operator runtime current date. Only report.pdf is read and rewritten; all
cover-page artwork is built in memory and merged in memory, so no unrelated
files are created or modified.
"""
import datetime
import io
import os
import sys

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.lib.units import inch
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

INPUT_PDF = "report.pdf"
TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"


def build_cover_page() -> bytes:
    """Render the cover page into an in-memory PDF and return its bytes."""
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    c = canvas.Canvas(buf, pagesize=letter)
    width, height = letter

    # Title, centered in the upper-middle area of the page.
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 30)
    c.setFillColorRGB(0.1, 0.1, 0.25)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2.0, height * 0.62, TITLE)

    # Decorative rule under the title.
    rule_width = 3.0 * inch
    c.setStrokeColorRGB(0.3, 0.3, 0.55)
    c.setLineWidth(2)
    c.line(width / 2.0 - rule_width / 2.0, height * 0.60,
           width / 2.0 + rule_width / 2.0, height * 0.60)

    # Current date (operator runtime date), centered below the title.
    today = datetime.date.today()
    date_str = today.strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 18)
    c.setFillColorRGB(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2.0, height * 0.55, date_str)

    c.showPage()
    c.save()
    return buf.getvalue()


def add_cover_page() -> None:
    if not os.path.isfile(INPUT_PDF):
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"{INPUT_PDF} does not exist in the workspace")

    reader = PdfReader(INPUT_PDF)
    original_pages = len(reader.pages)

    cover_bytes = build_cover_page()
    cover_reader = PdfReader(io.BytesIO(cover_bytes))

    writer = PdfWriter()
    writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
    for page in reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    with open(INPUT_PDF, "wb") as out:
        writer.write(out)

    # ---- Validation -------------------------------------------------
    final_reader = PdfReader(INPUT_PDF)
    if len(final_reader.pages) != original_pages + 1:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"Validation failed: expected {original_pages + 1} pages, "
            f"found {len(final_reader.pages)}"
        )

    page1_text = final_reader.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
    if TITLE not in page1_text:

        out += b"%d 0 obj\n" % i
        out += obj
        out += b"\nendobj\n"
    xref_pos = len(out)
    out += b"xref\n0 %d\n" % (len(objects) + 1)
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for off in offsets:
        out += b"%010d 00000 n \n" % off
    out += b"trailer\n<< /Size %d /Root 1 0 R >>\nstartxref\n%d\n%%%%EOF\n" % (
        len(objects) + 1, xref_pos)

    with open(cover_path, "wb") as f:
        f.write(bytes(out))


def create_cover_page(cover_path, today):
    try:
        _cover_with_reportlab(cover_path, today)
    except ImportError:
        _cover_raw_pdf(cover_path, today)

def _merge_with_pypdf(cover_path, report_path, out_path):

    )


def _merge_with_qpdf(cover_path, report_path, out_path):

        ["qpdf", "--empty", "--pages", cover_path, report_path, "--", out_path],
        check=True, capture_output=True, text=True,

    )

    subprocess.run(
        ["gs", "-q", "-dNOPAUSE", "-dBATCH", "-sDEVICE=pdfwrite",
         "-sOutputFile=" + out_path, cover_path, report_path],
        check=True, capture_output=True, text=True,
    )


_MERGE_STRATEGIES = (
    _merge_with_pypdf,
    _merge_with_pypdf2,
    _merge_with_pdfrw,
    _merge_with_pikepdf,
    _merge_with_fitz,
    _merge_with_pypdfium2,
    _merge_with_pdfunite,
    _merge_with_qpdf,
    _merge_with_pdftk,
    _merge_with_ghostscript,
)


def merge_cover_and_report(cover_path, report_path, out_path):
    failures = []
    for strategy in _MERGE_STRATEGIES:
        try:
            strategy(cover_path, report_path, out_path)
            if os.path.isfile(out_path) and os.path.getsize(out_path) > 0:
                print(f"Merged using {strategy.__name__}")
                return
        except Exception as exc:  # ImportError or CLI failure
            failures.append(f"{strategy.__name__}: {exc}")
    raise SystemExit("No PDF merge strategy succeeded:\n  " + "\n  ".join(failures))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# First-page text extraction for verification
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def first_page_text(pdf_path):
    """Extract the text of the first page using whichever reader is available."""
    try:
        from pypdf import PdfReader
        return PdfReader(pdf_path).pages[0].extract_text() or ""
    except ImportError:
        pass
    try:
        from PyPDF2 import PdfReader
        return PdfReader(pdf_path).pages[0].extract_text() or ""
    except ImportError:
        pass
    try:
        import pypdfium2 as pdfium
        page = pdfium.PdfDocument(pdf_path)[0]
        try:
            return page.get_text() or ""
        except AttributeError:
            return page.get_textpage().get_text_range() or ""
    except ImportError:
        pass
    try:
        import pdfplumber
        with pdfplumber.open(pdf_path) as pdf:
            return pdf.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
    except ImportError:
        pass
    try:
        import fitz
        return fitz.open(pdf_path)[0].get_text() or ""
    except ImportError:
        pass
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["pdftotext", "-f", "1", "-l", "1", pdf_path, "-"],
        check=True, capture_output=True, text=True,
    )
    return result.stdout


def main():
    report_path = find_report_pdf()
    if report_path is None:
        raise SystemExit("report.pdf not found in the workspace")

    today = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmpdir:
        cover_path = os.path.join(tmpdir, "cover.pdf")
        create_cover_page(cover_path, today)

        out_path = os.path.join(tmpdir, "report_with_cover.pdf")
        merge_cover_and_report(cover_path, report_path, out_path)

        check_text = first_page_text(out_path)
        if TITLE not in check_text:
            raise SystemExit("Verification failed: cover page title not found")
        if today not in check_text:
            raise SystemExit("Verification failed: cover page date not found")

        os.replace(out_path, report_path)

    print(f"Prepended cover page to {report_path}")
    print(f"Cover title: {TITLE}")
    print(f"Cover date: {today}")
    print("Verified: first page contains the title and the current date")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Task-necessary inspection of report.pdf and available PDF tooling.

Read-only: opens report.pdf in binary mode to report its structure (header,
object count, trailer, page count, presence of object streams / xref streams /
compression), and checks which PDF modules/CLI tools exist in this
environment. Does not modify any file.
"""
import importlib.util
import os
import re
import shutil
import sys

BASE_DIR = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
REPORT = os.path.join(BASE_DIR, "report.pdf")


def inspect_pdf(path):
    if not os.path.isfile(path):
        print(f"report.pdf NOT FOUND at {path}")
        return
    size = os.path.getsize(path)
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        data = f.read()
    print(f"report.pdf: {size} bytes")
    print(f"header: {data[:16]!r}")
    obj_nums = re.findall(rb"(?m)^\s*(\d+)\s+0\s+obj\b", data)
    print(f"top-level objects found: {len(obj_nums)} (sample: {obj_nums[:8]})")
    print(f"contains /ObjStm (object streams): {b'/ObjStm' in data}")
    print(f"contains /XRef stream: {b'/XRef' in data}")
    print(f"contains /Linearized: {b'/Linearized' in data}")
    print(f"contains FlateDecode filters: {b'/FlateDecode' in data}")
    print(f"contains /Encrypt: {b'/Encrypt' in data}")
    # Trailer / Pages info
    trailer_m = re.search(rb"trailer\s*<<(.*?)>>\s*startxref", data, re.S)
    if trailer_m:
        trailer = trailer_m.group(1)[:600]
        print(f"trailer (first 600 bytes): {trailer!r}")
    count_m = re.search(rb"/Count\s+(\d+)", data)
    if count_m:
        print(f"first /Count value found: {count_m.group(1).decode()}")
    root_m = re.search(rb"/Root\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", data)
    if root_m:
        print(f"/Root reference: {root_m.group(1).decode()} 0 R")


def check_tools():
    modules = [
        "reportlab", "pdf2image", "PIL", "pdfminer", "pdfminer.high_level",

        try:
            found = importlib.util.find_spec(mod) is not None
        except (ImportError, ValueError):

        print(f"  {mod}: {'available' if found else 'missing'}")

    binaries = [
        "pdftotext", "pdftoppm", "pdfimages", "pdfinfo", "pdftocairo",
        "pdftops", "pdfunite", "qpdf", "pdftk", "gs", "mutool", "magick",
        "convert", "python3",
    ]
    print("\nCLI tools on PATH:")
    for name in binaries:
        print(f"  {name}: {shutil.which(name) or 'missing'}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    inspect_pdf(REPORT)
    check_tools()
    print(f"\nsys.executable: {sys.executable}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page to report.pdf with the exact title 'Annual Financial Report'
and the operator runtime current date, then validate the result."""

import datetime
import io
import os
import tempfile

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"
REPORT_PATH = "report.pdf"


def build_cover_bytes() -> bytes:
    """Render a single-page letter-size cover PDF into memory."""
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    c = canvas.Canvas(buf, pagesize=letter)
    width, height = letter

    # Title
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 28)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2.0, height / 2.0 + 60, TITLE)

    # Current date (operator runtime date)
    date_text = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2.0, height / 2.0, date_text)

    c.save()
    return buf.getvalue()


def main() -> None:
    if not os.path.exists(REPORT_PATH):
        raise SystemExit(f"missing input: {REPORT_PATH}")

    date_text = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    cover = PdfReader(io.BytesIO(build_cover_bytes()))
    report = PdfReader(REPORT_PATH)
    original_count = len(report.pages)

    writer = PdfWriter()
    for page in cover.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)
    for page in report.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    # Write to a temp file in the same directory, then atomically replace the original.
    fd, tmp_path = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=".", prefix=".report_cover_", suffix=".pdf")
    os.close(fd)
    try:
        with open(tmp_path, "wb") as fh:
            writer.write(fh)
        os.replace(tmp_path, REPORT_PATH)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(tmp_path):
            os.unlink(tmp_path)

    # Validate the transformed file.
    result = PdfReader(REPORT_PATH)
    assert len(result.pages) == original_count + 1, "cover page was not prepended"
    first_text = result.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
    assert TITLE in first_text, "cover title missing from page 1"
    assert date_text in first_text, "cover date missing from page 1"

    print(f"OK: prepended cover page to {REPORT_PATH} ({original_count} -> {len(result.pages)} pages)")
    print(f"Cover title: {TITLE}")
    print(f"Cover date: {date_text}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Prepend a cover page to report.pdf with the exact title 'Annual Financial Report'
and the operator runtime current date, then validate the result.

The cover page is built as a dependency-free minimal valid PDF (standard-14
fonts, uncompressed content stream). Merging uses whichever supported PDF
library is available in this runtime: pypdf, PyPDF2, pypdfium2, PyMuPDF
(fitz), pikepdf, or pdfrw.
"""

import datetime
import io
import os
import stat
import sys
import tempfile

TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"
REPORT_PATH = "report.pdf"
PAGE_W = 612.0
PAGE_H = 792.0

# Helvetica metrics (units per 1000 em) for characters used by title/date.
HELV = {
    " ": 278, ",": 278, ".": 278,
    "0": 556, "1": 556, "2": 556, "3": 556, "4": 556,

HELV_BOLD = {

    "0": 556, "1": 556, "2": 556, "3": 556, "4": 556,
    "5": 556, "6": 556, "7": 556, "8": 556, "9": 556,
    "A": 722, "B": 722, "C": 722, "D": 722, "E": 667, "F": 611, "G": 778, "H": 722,
    "I": 278, "J": 556, "K": 722, "L": 611, "M": 833, "N": 722, "O": 778, "P": 667,
    "Q": 778, "R": 722, "S": 667, "T": 611, "U": 722, "V": 667, "W": 944, "X": 667,
    "Y": 667, "Z": 611,
    "a": 556, "b": 611, "c": 556, "d": 611, "e": 556, "f": 333, "g": 611, "h": 611,
    "i": 278, "j": 278, "k": 556, "l": 278, "m": 889, "n": 611, "o": 611, "p": 611,
    "q": 611, "r": 389, "s": 556, "t": 333, "u": 611, "v": 556, "w": 778, "x": 556,
    "y": 556, "z": 500,
}


def _pdf_escape(text):
    return text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def build_cover_pdf(title, date_text):
    """Build a minimal single-page letter-size cover PDF (no external deps)."""

    def string_width(text, table, size):
        return sum(table.get(ch, 556) for ch in text) / 1000.0 * size

    title_w = string_width(title, HELV_BOLD, 28)
    date_w = string_width(date_text, HELV, 16)
    title_x = (PAGE_W - title_w) / 2.0
    date_x = (PAGE_W - date_w) / 2.0
    title_y = 460.0
    date_y = 420.0

    content = (
        "BT\n/F1 28 Tf\n0 0 0 rg\n"
        f"{title_x:.2f} {title_y:.2f} Td\n({_pdf_escape(title)}) Tj\nET\n"
        "BT\n/F2 16 Tf\n0 0 0 rg\n"
        f"{date_x:.2f} {date_y:.2f} Td\n({_pdf_escape(date_text)}) Tj\nET\n"
    ).encode("latin-1")

    objects = [
        b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
        b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>",
        (b"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] "
         b"/Resources << /Font << /F1 4 0 R /F2 5 0 R >> >> /Contents 6 0 R >>"),
        b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold >>",
        b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>",
        b"<< /Length " + str(len(content)).encode("ascii") + b" >>\nstream\n"
        + content + b"\nendstream",
    ]

    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
    offsets = []
    for i, obj in enumerate(objects, start=1):
        offsets.append(len(out))
        out += b"%d 0 obj\n" % i
        out += obj
        out += b"\nendobj\n"

    xref_pos = len(out)
    out += b"xref\n0 %d\n" % (len(objects) + 1)
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f\r\n"
    for off in offsets:
        out += b"%010d 00000 n\r\n" % off
    out += (b"trailer\n<< /Size %d /Root 1 0 R >>\nstartxref\n%d\n%%%%EOF\n"
            % (len(objects) + 1, xref_pos))
    return bytes(out)


def merge(cover_bytes, report_path, out_path):
    """Prepend cover_bytes to report_path, writing out_path. Returns (lib, original_count)."""
    errors = []

    # pypdf
    try:
        from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
        writer = PdfWriter()
        for page in PdfReader(io.BytesIO(cover_bytes)).pages:
            writer.add_page(page)
        report = PdfReader(report_path)
        for page in report.pages:
            writer.add_page(page)
        with open(out_path, "wb") as fh:
            writer.write(fh)
        return "pypdf", len(report.pages)
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        errors.append(f"pypdf: {exc!r}")

    # PyPDF2
    try:
        import PyPDF2
        writer = PyPDF2.PdfWriter()
        for page in PyPDF2.PdfReader(io.BytesIO(cover_bytes)).pages:
            writer.add_page(page)
        report = PyPDF2.PdfReader(report_path)
        for page in report.pages:
            writer.add_page(page)
        with open(out_path, "wb") as fh:
            writer.write(fh)
        return "PyPDF2", len(report.pages)
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        errors.append(f"PyPDF2: {exc!r}")

    # pypdfium2
    try:
        import pypdfium2 as pdfium
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".pdf", delete=False) as tmp:
            tmp.write(cover_bytes)
            cover_path = tmp.name
        try:
            cover_doc = pdfium.PdfDocument(cover_path)
            report_doc = pdfium.PdfDocument(report_path)
            merged = pdfium.PdfDocument.new()
            merged.import_pages(cover_doc)
            merged.import_pages(report_doc)
            count = len(report_doc)
            merged.save(out_path)
        finally:
            os.unlink(cover_path)
        return "pypdfium2", count
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        errors.append(f"pypdfium2: {exc!r}")

    # PyMuPDF
    try:
        import fitz
        merged = fitz.open()
        cover_doc = fitz.open(stream=cover_bytes, filetype="pdf")
        report_doc = fitz.open(report_path)
        merged.insert_pdf(cover_doc)
        merged.insert_pdf(report_doc)
        count = len(report_doc)
        merged.save(out_path)
        return "fitz", count
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        errors.append(f"fitz: {exc!r}")

    # pikepdf
    try:
        import pikepdf
        cover_doc = pikepdf.open(io.BytesIO(cover_bytes))
        report_doc = pikepdf.open(report_path)
        merged = pikepdf.Pdf.new()
        merged.pages.extend(cover_doc.pages)
        merged.pages.extend(report_doc.pages)
        count = len(report_doc.pages)
        merged.save(out_path)
        return "pikepdf", count
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        errors.append(f"pikepdf: {exc!r}")

    # pdfrw
    try:
        from pdfrw import PdfReader, PdfWriter
        cover_doc = PdfReader(data=cover_bytes)
        report_doc = PdfReader(report_path)
        out_doc = PdfReader()
        out_doc.pages = cover_doc.pages + report_doc.pages
        PdfWriter(out_path, trailer=out_doc).write()
        return "pdfrw", len(report_doc.pages)
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        errors.append(f"pdfrw: {exc!r}")

    raise SystemExit("No usable PDF merge library available. Errors:\n"
                     + "\n".join(errors))


def inspect(path):
    """Return (page_count, first_page_text) using the first available library."""
    try:
        from pypdf import PdfReader
        reader = PdfReader(path)
        return len(reader.pages), (reader.pages[0].extract_text() or "")
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
        pass
    try:
        import PyPDF2
        reader = PyPDF2.PdfReader(path)
        return len(reader.pages), (reader.pages[0].extract_text() or "")
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
        pass
    try:
        import pypdfium2 as pdfium
        doc = pdfium.PdfDocument(path)
        return len(doc), (doc[0].get_text() or "")
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
        pass
    try:
        import fitz
        doc = fitz.open(path)
        return len(doc), (doc[0].get_text() or "")
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
        pass
    return None, None


def main():
    if not os.path.exists(REPORT_PATH):
        raise SystemExit(f"missing input: {REPORT_PATH}")

    date_text = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    cover_bytes = build_cover_pdf(TITLE, date_text)
    orig_mode = stat.S_IMODE(os.stat(REPORT_PATH).st_mode)

    fd, tmp_path = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=".", prefix=".report_cover_", suffix=".pdf")
    os.close(fd)
    try:
        lib, original_count = merge(cover_bytes, REPORT_PATH, tmp_path)
        os.replace(tmp_path, REPORT_PATH)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(tmp_path):
            os.unlink(tmp_path)
    os.chmod(REPORT_PATH, orig_mode)

    count, first_text = inspect(REPORT_PATH)
    if count is None:
        raise SystemExit("Could not re-open result for validation")
    expected = original_count + 1
    if count != expected:
        raise SystemExit(f"validation failed: expected {expected} pages, got {count}")
    if not first_text or TITLE not in first_text:
        raise SystemExit(f"validation failed: cover title missing from page 1 (text: {first_text!r})")
    if not first_text or date_text not in first_text:
        raise SystemExit(f"validation failed: cover date missing from page 1 (text: {first_text!r})")

    print(f"OK: prepended cover page to {REPORT_PATH} (merged with {lib})")
    print(f"Pages: {original_count} -> {count}")
    print(f"Cover title: {TITLE}")
    print(f"Cover date: {date_text}")
    print(f"Page 1 text: {first_text!r}")


if __name__ == "__main__":

        mc = re.search(rb"/Count\s+(\d+)", new_pages_raw)
        if mc:
            new_pages_raw = (new_pages_raw[:mc.start(1)]
                             + str(original_count + 1).encode()
                             + new_pages_raw[mc.end(1):])
        else:
            idx = new_pages_raw.rfind(b">>")

                raise SystemExit("page-tree node has no closing '>>'")

                             + b" /Count %d" % (original_count + 1)
                             + new_pages_raw[idx:])

        new_objects = cover_objs
        new_root = None
        expected = original_count + 1
    elif ptype == b"Page":
        # Single-page document whose catalog /Pages points directly at the page.
        new_pages_num = next_num
        next_num += 1
        new_cat_num = next_num
        next_num += 1
        cover_objs, cover_num, next_num = build_cover_objects(
            next_num, new_pages_num, TITLE, date_text)
        new_pages_obj = (b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [%d 0 R %d 0 R] /Count 2 >>"
                         % (cover_num, pages_num))
        cat_new = re.sub(rb"(/Pages\s+)(\d+)(\s+\d+\s+R)",
                         rb"\g<1>%d\g<3>" % new_pages_num, cat_raw, count=1)
        new_objects = [(new_pages_num, new_pages_obj),
                       (new_cat_num, cat_new)] + cover_objs
        modified_pages = None
        new_root = new_cat_num
        expected = 2
    else:
        raise SystemExit("unexpected page-tree structure (no /Kids and not /Page)")

    orig_mode = stat.S_IMODE(os.stat(REPORT_PATH).st_mode)
    fd, tmp_path = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=".", prefix=".report_cover_", suffix=".pdf")
    os.close(fd)
    try:
        out_bytes = assemble(data, xref, trailer, modified_pages, new_objects, new_root)
        with open(tmp_path, "wb") as fh:
            fh.write(out_bytes)
        os.replace(tmp_path, REPORT_PATH)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(tmp_path):
            os.unlink(tmp_path)
    os.chmod(REPORT_PATH, orig_mode)

    # --- Structural validation of the transformed file ---
    with open(REPORT_PATH, "rb") as fh:
        vdata = fh.read()
    vxref, vtrailer = load_xref(vdata)
    vroot = vtrailer.get("root")
    if vroot is None or vroot not in vxref:
        raise SystemExit("validation failed: /Root not found after transform")
    vcat = read_object(vdata, vxref[vroot][0])
    vpages_num = extract_ref(vcat, b"Pages")
    vpages_raw = read_object(vdata, vxref[vpages_num][0])
    vkids = extract_kids(vpages_raw)
    vcount = extract_count(vpages_raw)
    if vkids is None or vcount != expected:
        raise SystemExit(f"validation failed: page count {vcount}, kids {vkids}, expected {expected}")
    vcover_num = vkids[0]
    if vcover_num not in vxref:
        raise SystemExit("validation failed: cover page object not in xref")
    vcover_raw = read_object(vdata, vxref[vcover_num][0])
    vcontent_num = extract_ref(vcover_raw, b"Contents")
    if vcontent_num is None or vcontent_num not in vxref:
        raise SystemExit("validation failed: cover content stream missing")
    vcontent_raw = read_object(vdata, vxref[vcontent_num][0])
    if TITLE.encode("latin-1") not in vcontent_raw:
        raise SystemExit("validation failed: cover title not found on page 1")
    if date_text.encode("latin-1") not in vcontent_raw:
        raise SystemExit("validation failed: cover date not found on page 1")

    print(f"OK: prepended cover page to {REPORT_PATH}")
    print(f"Pages: {expected - 1} -> {expected}")
    print(f"Cover title: {TITLE}")
    print(f"Cover date: {date_text}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

    matches = list(re.finditer(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data))
    if not matches:
        raise ValueError("no 'startxref' found")
    offset = int(matches[-1].group(1))
    chain = []
    seen = set()
    while offset and offset not in seen:
        seen.add(offset)
        table = parse_xref_table(data, offset)
        trailer = parse_trailer(data, offset)
        chain.append((table, trailer))
        offset = trailer.get("prev", 0)
    if not chain:
        raise ValueError("no xref table found")
    xref = {}
    for table, _ in reversed(chain):  # oldest -> newest so newest wins
        for num, val in table.items():
            xref[num] = val
    return xref, chain[0][1]


def extract_ref(raw, key):
    m = re.search(rb"/" + key + rb"\s+(\d+)\s+\d+\s+R", raw)
    return int(m.group(1)) if m else None


def extract_kids(raw):
    m = re.search(rb"/Kids\s*\[(.*?)\]", raw, re.S)
    if not m:
        return None
    return [int(x) for x in re.findall(rb"(\d+)\s+\d+\s+R", m.group(1))]


def extract_count(raw):
    m = re.search(rb"/Count\s+(\d+)", raw)
    return int(m.group(1)) if m else None


def locate_catalog_and_pages(data, xref, trailer):
    """Return (catalog_raw, pages_num). Falls back to scanning objects."""
    diagnostics = []
    root = trailer.get("root")
    if root is not None:
        diagnostics.append(f"trailer /Root = {root}, /Size = {trailer.get('size')}, "
                           f"/Prev = {trailer.get('prev')}")
        if root in xref:
            off = xref[root][0]
            raw = read_object(data, off)
            diagnostics.append(f"object {root} at {off} starts: {raw[:160]!r}")
            pages_num = extract_ref(raw, b"Pages")
            if pages_num is not None and pages_num in xref:
                return raw, pages_num
            diagnostics.append(f"no /Pages ref found in object {root}")
        else:
            diagnostics.append(f"root {root} not present in xref")
    else:
        diagnostics.append("no /Root in trailer")

    # Fallback: scan every live object for a catalog with a /Pages reference.
    for num in sorted(xref):
        off, gen, used = xref[num]
        if not used:
            continue
        try:
            raw = read_object(data, off)
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            continue
        if b"/Type /Catalog" in raw:
            pages_num = extract_ref(raw, b"Pages")
            if pages_num is not None and pages_num in xref:
                diagnostics.append(f"scanned catalog found: object {num} -> /Pages {pages_num}")
                return raw, pages_num
    raise SystemExit("could not locate page tree (/Pages).\n" + "\n".join(diagnostics))


def locate_pages_node(data, xref, pages_num, diagnostics):
    """Return (pages_raw, kids, count, ptype) for the given pages node."""
    if pages_num not in xref:
        raise SystemExit(f"/Pages {pages_num} not present in xref.\n" + "\n".join(diagnostics))
    raw = read_object(data, xref[pages_num][0])
    mtype = re.search(rb"/Type\s*/(\w+)", raw)
    ptype = mtype.group(1) if mtype else b""
    kids = extract_kids(raw)
    count = extract_count(raw)
    diagnostics.append(f"pages node {pages_num} type={ptype.decode(errors='replace')} "
                       f"kids={kids} count={count}")
    return raw, kids, count, ptype


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# New cover-page objects
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def build_cover_objects(next_num, pages_ref, title, date_text):
    content = build_cover_content(title, date_text)
    content_num = next_num
    bold_num = next_num + 1
    reg_num = next_num + 2
    page_num = next_num + 3
    objs = [
        (content_num,
         b"<< /Length %d >>\nstream\n" % len(content) + content + b"\nendstream"),
        (bold_num, b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold >>"),
        (reg_num, b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>"),
        (page_num,
         b"<< /Type /Page /Parent %d 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] "
         b"/Resources << /Font << /F1 %d 0 R /F2 %d 0 R >> >> /Contents %d 0 R >>"
         % (pages_ref, bold_num, reg_num, content_num)),
    ]
    return objs, page_num, next_num + 4


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# File assembly
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def assemble(data, xref, trailer, modified_pages, new_objects, new_root):
    """Rebuild the PDF: original bytes kept, new objects appended, new xref/trailer."""
    offsets = {num: [off, gen, used] for num, (off, gen, used) in xref.items()}
    chunks = [data]
    pos = len(data)

    def append(raw):
        nonlocal pos
        chunks.append(b"\n")
        pos += 1
        chunks.append(raw)
        pos += len(raw)

    if modified_pages is not None:
        num, raw = modified_pages
        offsets[num] = [pos, 0, True]
        append(raw)
    for num, raw in new_objects:
        offsets[num] = [pos, 0, True]
        append(raw)

    body = b"".join(chunks)
    out = bytearray(body)
    xref_pos = len(out)
    max_num = max(offsets) if offsets else 0
    size = max(trailer.get("size", 0), max_num + 1)
    out += b"xref\n0 %d\n" % size
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f\r\n"
    for num in range(1, size):
        if num in offsets:
            off, gen, used = offsets[num]
            flag = b"n" if used else b"f"
            out += b"%010d %05d %s\r\n" % (off, gen, flag)
        else:
            out += b"0000000000 65535 f\r\n"
    root = new_root if new_root is not None else trailer.get("root")
    if root is None:
        raise ValueError("no /Root in trailer")
    out += b"trailer\n<< /Size %d /Root %d 0 R" % (size, root)
    if trailer.get("info"):
        out += b" /Info %d 0 R" % trailer["info"]
    if trailer.get("id"):
        out += b" /ID [%s]" % trailer["id"]
    out += b" >>\nstartxref\n%d\n%%%%EOF\n" % xref_pos
    return bytes(out)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def main():
    if not os.path.exists(REPORT_PATH):
        raise SystemExit(f"missing input: {REPORT_PATH}")
    with open(REPORT_PATH, "rb") as fh:
        data = fh.read()
    if not data.startswith(b"%PDF"):
        raise SystemExit(f"{REPORT_PATH} does not look like a PDF file")

    xref, trailer = load_xref(data)
    diagnostics = []
    cat_raw, pages_num = locate_catalog_and_pages(data, xref, trailer, diagnostics)
    pages_raw, kids, count, ptype = locate_pages_node(data, xref, pages_num, diagnostics)

    date_text = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    next_num = max(xref) + 1

    if kids is not None:
        original_count = count if count is not None else len(kids)
        cover_objs, cover_num, next_num = build_cover_objects(
            next_num, pages_num, TITLE, date_text)
        m = re.search(rb"/Kids\s*\[(.*?)\]", pages_raw, re.S)
        new_kids = b" ".join(b"%d 0 R" % n for n in [cover_num] + kids)
        new_pages_raw = pages_raw[:m.start(1)] + new_kids + pages_raw[m.end(1):]
        mc = re.search(rb"/Count\s+(\d+)", new_pages_raw)
        if mc:
            new_pages_raw = (new_pages_raw[:mc.start(1)]
                             + str(original_count + 1).encode()
                             + new_pages_raw[mc.end(1):])
        else:
            idx = new_pages_raw.rfind(b">>")
            if idx == -1:
                raise SystemExit("page-tree node has no closing '>>'")
            new_pages_raw = (new_pages_raw[:idx]
                             + b" /Count %d" % (original_count + 1)
                             + new_pages_raw[idx:])
        modified_pages = (pages_num, new_pages_raw)
        new_objects = cover_objs
        new_root = None
        expected = original_count + 1
    elif ptype == b"Page":
        # Single-page document whose catalog /Pages points directly at the page.
        new_pages_num = next_num
        next_num += 1
        new_cat_num = next_num
        next_num += 1
        cover_objs, cover_num, next_num = build_cover_objects(
            next_num, new_pages_num, TITLE, date_text)
        new_pages_obj = (b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [%d 0 R %d 0 R] /Count 2 >>"
                         % (cover_num, pages_num))
        cat_new = re.sub(rb"(/Pages\s+)(\d+)(\s+\d+\s+R)",
                         rb"\g<1>%d\g<3>" % new_pages_num, cat_raw, count=1)
        new_objects = [(new_pages_num, new_pages_obj),
                       (new_cat_num, cat_new)] + cover_objs
        modified_pages = None
        new_root = new_cat_num
        expected = 2
    else:
        raise SystemExit("unexpected page-tree structure (no /Kids and not /Page)\n"
                         + "\n".join(diagnostics))

    orig_mode = stat.S_IMODE(os.stat(REPORT_PATH).st_mode)
    fd, tmp_path = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=".", prefix=".report_cover_", suffix=".pdf")
    os.close(fd)
    try:
        out_bytes = assemble(data, xref, trailer, modified_pages, new_objects, new_root)
        with open(tmp_path, "wb") as fh:
            fh.write(out_bytes)
        os.replace(tmp_path, REPORT_PATH)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(tmp_path):
            os.unlink(tmp_path)
    os.chmod(REPORT_PATH, orig_mode)

    # --- Structural validation of the transformed file ---
    with open(REPORT_PATH, "rb") as fh:
        vdata = fh.read()
    vxref, vtrailer = load_xref(vdata)
    vroot = vtrailer.get("root")
    if vroot is None or vroot not in vxref:
        raise SystemExit("validation failed: /Root not found after transform")
    vcat = read_object(vdata, vxref[vroot][0])
    vpages_num = extract_ref(vcat, b"Pages")
    vpages_raw = read_object(vdata, vxref[vpages_num][0])
    vkids = extract_kids(vpages_raw)
    vcount = extract_count(vpages_raw)
    if vkids is None or vcount != expected:
        raise SystemExit(f"validation failed: page count {vcount}, kids {vkids}, expected {expected}")
    vcover_num = vkids[0]
    if vcover_num not in vxref:
        raise SystemExit("validation failed: cover page object not in xref")
    vcover_raw = read_object(vdata, vxref[vcover_num][0])
    vcontent_num = extract_ref(vcover_raw, b"Contents")
    if vcontent_num is None or vcontent_num not in vxref:
        raise SystemExit("validation failed: cover content stream missing")
    vcontent_raw = read_object(vdata, vxref[vcontent_num][0])
    if TITLE.encode("latin-1") not in vcontent_raw:
        raise SystemExit("validation failed: cover title not found on page 1")
    if date_text.encode("latin-1") not in vcontent_raw:
        raise SystemExit("validation failed: cover date not found on page 1")

    print("structure:", "; ".join(diagnostics))
    print(f"OK: prepended cover page to {REPORT_PATH}")
    print(f"Pages: {expected - 1} -> {expected}")
    print(f"Cover title: {TITLE}")
    print(f"Cover date: {date_text}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

def _pdf_escape(text):
    return text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def build_cover_content(title, date_text):
    """Return the page content stream (bytes) for the letter-size cover page."""
    def string_width(text, table, size):
        return sum(table.get(ch, 556) for ch in text) / 1000.0 * size

    title_w = string_width(title, HELV_BOLD, 28)
    date_w = string_width(date_text, HELV, 16)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PDF structure parsing (classic xref tables only)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def read_object(data, offset):
    """Return raw bytes of the object starting at offset (through 'endobj')."""
    end = data.find(b"endobj", offset)
    if end == -1:
        raise ValueError(f"'endobj' not found at offset {offset}")
    return data[offset:end + len(b"endobj")]


def parse_xref_table(data, offset):
    """Parse a classic xref table -> {objnum: (offset, generation, in_use)}."""
    if data[offset:offset + 4] != b"xref":
        raise ValueError(f"expected 'xref' at offset {offset}, got {data[offset:offset + 12]!r}")
    pos = offset + 4
    entries = {}
    while pos < len(data):
        while pos < len(data) and data[pos] in b" \t\r\n":
            pos += 1
        m = re.match(rb"(\d+)\s+(\d+)", data[pos:pos + 32])
        if not m:
            break
        first, count = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2))
        pos += m.end()
        for i in range(count):
            line = data[pos:pos + 20]
            if len(line) < 19:
                raise ValueError("truncated xref entry")
            off = int(line[0:10])
            gen = int(line[11:16])
            used = line[17:18] == b"n"
            entries[first + i] = (off, gen, used)
            if line[18:20] == b"\r\n":
                pos += 20
            elif line[18:19] == b"\n":
                pos += 19
            else:
                pos += 20
    return entries


def parse_trailer(data, start):
    """Parse the trailer dictionary after an xref table (best effort)."""
    t = data.find(b"trailer", start)
    if t == -1:
        return {}
    d = data.find(b"<<", t)
    if d == -1:
        return {}
    seg = data[d:d + 8192]
    info = {}
    m = re.search(rb"/Root\s+(\d+)\s+\d+\s+R", seg)
    if m:
        info["root"] = int(m.group(1))
    m = re.search(rb"/Size\s+(\d+)", seg)
    if m:
        info["size"] = int(m.group(1))
    m = re.search(rb"/Prev\s+(\d+)", seg)
    if m:
        info["prev"] = int(m.group(1))
    m = re.search(rb"/Info\s+(\d+)\s+\d+\s+R", seg)
    if m:
        info["info"] = int(m.group(1))
    m = re.search(rb"/ID\s*\[(.*?)\]", seg, re.S)
    if m:
        info["id"] = m.group(1).strip()
    return info


def load_xref(data):
    """Load the live xref map (following /Prev chains) and the latest trailer."""
    matches = list(re.finditer(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data))
    if not matches:
        raise ValueError("no 'startxref' found")
    offset = int(matches[-1].group(1))
    chain = []
    seen = set()
    while offset and offset not in seen:
        seen.add(offset)
        table = parse_xref_table(data, offset)
        trailer = parse_trailer(data, offset)
        chain.append((table, trailer))
        offset = trailer.get("prev", 0)
    if not chain:
        raise ValueError("no xref table found")
    xref = {}
    for table, _ in reversed(chain):  # oldest -> newest so newest wins
        for num, val in table.items():
            xref[num] = val
    return xref, chain[0][1]


def extract_ref(raw, key):
    m = re.search(rb"/" + key + rb"\s+(\d+)\s+\d+\s+R", raw)
    return int(m.group(1)) if m else None


def extract_kids(raw):
    m = re.search(rb"/Kids\s*\[(.*?)\]", raw, re.S)
    if not m:
        return None
    return [int(x) for x in re.findall(rb"(\d+)\s+\d+\s+R", m.group(1))]


def extract_count(raw):
    m = re.search(rb"/Count\s+(\d+)", raw)
    return int(m.group(1)) if m else None


def locate_catalog_and_pages(data, xref, trailer, diagnostics):
    """Return (catalog_raw, pages_num). Falls back to scanning objects."""
    root = trailer.get("root")
    if root is not None:
        diagnostics.append(f"trailer /Root = {root}, /Size = {trailer.get('size')}, "
                           f"/Prev = {trailer.get('prev')}")
        if root in xref:
            off = xref[root][0]
            raw = read_object(data, off)
            diagnostics.append(f"object {root} at {off} starts: {raw[:160]!r}")
            pages_num = extract_ref(raw, b"Pages")
            if pages_num is not None and pages_num in xref:
                return raw, pages_num
            diagnostics.append(f"no /Pages ref found in object {root}")
        else:
            diagnostics.append(f"root {root} not present in xref")
    else:
        diagnostics.append("no /Root in trailer")

    # Fallback: scan every live object for a catalog with a /Pages reference.
    for num in sorted(xref):
        off, gen, used = xref[num]
        if not used:
            continue
        try:
            raw = read_object(data, off)
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            continue
        if b"/Type /Catalog" in raw:
            pages_num = extract_ref(raw, b"Pages")
            if pages_num is not None and pages_num in xref:
                diagnostics.append(f"scanned catalog found: object {num} -> /Pages {pages_num}")
                return raw, pages_num
    raise SystemExit("could not locate page tree (/Pages).\n" + "\n".join(diagnostics))

    """Return (pages_raw, kids, count, ptype) for the given pages node."""
    if pages_num not in xref:
        raise SystemExit(f"/Pages {pages_num} not present in xref.\n" + "\n".join(diagnostics))
    raw = read_object(data, xref[pages_num][0])
    mtype = re.search(rb"/Type\s*/(\w+)", raw)
    ptype = mtype.group(1) if mtype else b""
    kids = extract_kids(raw)
    count = extract_count(raw)
    diagnostics.append(f"pages node {pages_num} type={ptype.decode(errors='replace')} "
                       f"kids={kids} count={count}")

         % (pages_ref, bold_num, reg_num, content_num)),

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# File assembly
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def assemble(data, xref, trailer, modified_pages, new_objects, new_root):
    """Rebuild the PDF: original bytes kept, new objects appended, new xref/trailer."""
    offsets = {num: [off, gen, used] for num, (off, gen, used) in xref.items()}
    chunks = [data]
    pos = len(data)

    def append(raw):

        append(raw)

        append(raw)

    out = bytearray(body)
    xref_pos = len(out)
    max_num = max(offsets) if offsets else 0
    size = max(trailer.get("size", 0), max_num + 1)
    out += b"xref\n0 %d\n" % size
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f\r\n"
    for num in range(1, size):

        else:

    root = new_root if new_root is not None else trailer.get("root")

    out += b"trailer\n<< /Size %d /Root %d 0 R" % (size, root)

    if trailer.get("id"):
        out += b" /ID [%s]" % trailer["id"]
    out += b" >>\nstartxref\n%d\n%%%%EOF\n" % xref_pos
    return bytes(out)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def main():
    if not os.path.exists(REPORT_PATH):
        raise SystemExit(f"missing input: {REPORT_PATH}")
    with open(REPORT_PATH, "rb") as fh:
        data = fh.read()
    if not data.startswith(b"%PDF"):
        raise SystemExit(f"{REPORT_PATH} does not look like a PDF file")

    xref, trailer = load_xref(data)
    diagnostics = []
    cat_raw, pages_num = locate_catalog_and_pages(data, xref, trailer, diagnostics)
    pages_raw, kids, count, ptype = locate_pages_node(data, xref, pages_num, diagnostics)

    date_text = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    next_num = max(xref) + 1

    if kids is not None:
        original_count = count if count is not None else len(kids)
        cover_objs, cover_num, next_num = build_cover_objects(
            next_num, pages_num, TITLE, date_text)
        m = re.search(rb"/Kids\s*\[(.*?)\]", pages_raw, re.S)
        new_kids = b" ".join(b"%d 0 R" % n for n in [cover_num] + kids)
        new_pages_raw = pages_raw[:m.start(1)] + new_kids + pages_raw[m.end(1):]
        mc = re.search(rb"/Count\s+(\d+)", new_pages_raw)
        if mc:
            new_pages_raw = (new_pages_raw[:mc.start(1)]
                             + str(original_count + 1).encode()
                             + new_pages_raw[mc.end(1):])
        else:
            idx = new_pages_raw.rfind(b">>")
            if idx == -1:
                raise SystemExit("page-tree node has no closing '>>'")
            new_pages_raw = (new_pages_raw[:idx]
                             + b" /Count %d" % (original_count + 1)
                             + new_pages_raw[idx:])
        modified_pages = (pages_num, new_pages_raw)
        new_objects = cover_objs
        new_root = None
        expected = original_count + 1
    elif ptype == b"Page":
        # Single-page document whose catalog /Pages points directly at the page.
        new_pages_num = next_num
        next_num += 1
        new_cat_num = next_num
        next_num += 1
        cover_objs, cover_num, next_num = build_cover_objects(
            next_num, new_pages_num, TITLE, date_text)
        new_pages_obj = (b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [%d 0 R %d 0 R] /Count 2 >>"
                         % (cover_num, pages_num))
        cat_new = re.sub(rb"(/Pages\s+)(\d+)(\s+\d+\s+R)",
                         rb"\g<1>%d\g<3>" % new_pages_num, cat_raw, count=1)
        new_objects = [(new_pages_num, new_pages_obj),
                       (new_cat_num, cat_new)] + cover_objs
        modified_pages = None
        new_root = new_cat_num
        expected = 2
    else:
        raise SystemExit("unexpected page-tree structure (no /Kids and not /Page)\n"
                         + "\n".join(diagnostics))

    orig_mode = stat.S_IMODE(os.stat(REPORT_PATH).st_mode)
    fd, tmp_path = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=".", prefix=".report_cover_", suffix=".pdf")
    os.close(fd)
    try:
        out_bytes = assemble(data, xref, trailer, modified_pages, new_objects, new_root)
        with open(tmp_path, "wb") as fh:
            fh.write(out_bytes)
        os.replace(tmp_path, REPORT_PATH)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(tmp_path):
            os.unlink(tmp_path)
    os.chmod(REPORT_PATH, orig_mode)

    # --- Structural validation of the transformed file ---
    with open(REPORT_PATH, "rb") as fh:
        vdata = fh.read()
    vxref, vtrailer = load_xref(vdata)
    vroot = vtrailer.get("root")
    if vroot is None or vroot not in vxref:
        raise SystemExit("validation failed: /Root not found after transform")
    vcat = read_object(vdata, vxref[vroot][0])
    vpages_num = extract_ref(vcat, b"Pages")
    vpages_raw = read_object(vdata, vxref[vpages_num][0])
    vkids = extract_kids(vpages_raw)
    vcount = extract_count(vpages_raw)
    if vkids is None or vcount != expected:
        raise SystemExit(f"validation failed: page count {vcount}, kids {vkids}, expected {expected}")
    vcover_num = vkids[0]
    if vcover_num not in vxref:
        raise SystemExit("validation failed: cover page object not in xref")
    vcover_raw = read_object(vdata, vxref[vcover_num][0])
    vcontent_num = extract_ref(vcover_raw, b"Contents")
    if vcontent_num is None or vcontent_num not in vxref:
        raise SystemExit("validation failed: cover content stream missing")
    vcontent_raw = read_object(vdata, vxref[vcontent_num][0])
    if TITLE.encode("latin-1") not in vcontent_raw:
        raise SystemExit("validation failed: cover title not found on page 1")
    if date_text.encode("latin-1") not in vcontent_raw:
        raise SystemExit("validation failed: cover date not found on page 1")

    print(f"Pages: {expected - 1} -> {expected}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Task-local helper: prepend a cover page to report.pdf.

Creates a letter-size cover page with the exact title "Annual Financial
Report" and the operator runtime current date, then prepends it to the
existing report.pdf (writing report.pdf in place via an atomic replace).
Only report.pdf is touched; no network or package installs.
"""

import datetime
import io
import os
import sys

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

INPUT_PDF = "report.pdf"
TEMP_PDF = "report_with_cover.tmp.pdf"
TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"


def build_cover_pdf_bytes() -> bytes:
    """Return a one-page letter-size PDF with the title and current date."""
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    c = canvas.Canvas(buf, pagesize=letter)
    width, height = letter

    today = datetime.date.today()
    date_str = today.strftime("%B %d, %Y")

    # Title, centered horizontally and vertically.
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 30)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2.0, height / 2.0 + 20, TITLE)

    # Date underneath the title.
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 18)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2.0, height / 2.0 - 30, date_str)

    # Decorative rule above and below.
    c.setLineWidth(1.5)
    c.line(width / 2.0 - 150, height / 2.0 + 55, width / 2.0 + 150, height / 2.0 + 55)
    c.line(width / 2.0 - 150, height / 2.0 - 60, width / 2.0 + 150, height / 2.0 - 60)

    c.showPage()
    c.save()
    return buf.getvalue()


def main() -> None:
    if not os.path.exists(INPUT_PDF):
        print(f"FAILURE: {INPUT_PDF} not found in {os.getcwd()}")
        sys.exit(1)

    reader = PdfReader(INPUT_PDF)
    original_count = len(reader.pages)
    print(f"Read {INPUT_PDF}: {original_count} page(s)")

    cover_bytes = build_cover_pdf_bytes()
    cover_reader = PdfReader(io.BytesIO(cover_bytes))
    cover_text = cover_reader.pages[0].extract_text()
    print(f"Cover page text extracted for validation: {cover_text!r}")

    writer = PdfWriter()
    writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])  # cover page first
    for page in reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    with open(TEMP_PDF, "wb") as f:
        writer.write(f)

    os.replace(TEMP_PDF, INPUT_PDF)  # atomically replace report.pdf
    print(f"Wrote {INPUT_PDF} with cover page prepended")

    # Validation pass: reopen and verify.
    check_reader = PdfReader(INPUT_PDF)
    new_count = len(check_reader.pages)
    first_text = check_reader.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
    print(f"Validation: {INPUT_PDF} now has {new_count} page(s) (was {original_count})")

    ok = True
    if new_count != original_count + 1:
        print("FAILURE: page count did not increase by exactly one")
        ok = False
    if TITLE not in first_text:
        print("FAILURE: title not found on cover page")
        ok = False
    if date_str := datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y"):
        if date_str not in first_text:
            print("FAILURE: current date not found on cover page")
            ok = False
    if ok:
        print(f"SUCCESS: cover page added with title {TITLE!r} and date {datetime.date.today().strftime('%B %d, %Y')}")
    else:
        sys.exit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Task-local helper: prepend a cover page to report.pdf.

The cover page contains the exact title "Annual Financial Report" and the
operator runtime current date. Only report.pdf is read and rewritten; all
cover-page artwork is built in memory and merged in memory, so no unrelated
files are created or modified.
"""
import datetime
import io
import os
import sys

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.lib.units import inch
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

INPUT_PDF = "report.pdf"
TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"


def build_cover_page() -> bytes:
    """Render the cover page into an in-memory PDF and return its bytes."""
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    c = canvas.Canvas(buf, pagesize=letter)
    width, height = letter

    # Title, centered in the upper-middle area of the page.
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 30)
    c.setFillColorRGB(0.1, 0.1, 0.25)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2.0, height * 0.62, TITLE)

    # Decorative rule under the title.
    rule_width = 3.0 * inch
    c.setStrokeColorRGB(0.3, 0.3, 0.55)
    c.setLineWidth(2)
    c.line(width / 2.0 - rule_width / 2.0, height * 0.60,
           width / 2.0 + rule_width / 2.0, height * 0.60)

    # Current date (operator runtime date), centered below the title.
    today = datetime.date.today()
    date_str = today.strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 18)
    c.setFillColorRGB(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2.0, height * 0.55, date_str)

    c.showPage()
    c.save()
    return buf.getvalue()


def add_cover_page() -> None:
    if not os.path.isfile(INPUT_PDF):
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"{INPUT_PDF} does not exist in the workspace")

    reader = PdfReader(INPUT_PDF)
    original_pages = len(reader.pages)

    cover_bytes = build_cover_page()
    cover_reader = PdfReader(io.BytesIO(cover_bytes))

    writer = PdfWriter()
    writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
    for page in reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    with open(INPUT_PDF, "wb") as out:
        writer.write(out)

    # ---- Validation -------------------------------------------------
    final_reader = PdfReader(INPUT_PDF)
    if len(final_reader.pages) != original_pages + 1:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"Validation failed: expected {original_pages + 1} pages, "
            f"found {len(final_reader.pages)}"
        )

    page1_text = final_reader.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
    if TITLE not in page1_text:
        raise RuntimeError("Validation failed: cover title not found on page 1")
    if date_str not in page1_text:
        raise RuntimeError("Validation failed: current date not found on page 1")

    print(f"OK: prepended cover page to {INPUT_PDF}")
    print(f"  Title: {TITLE}")
    print(f"  Date: {date_str}")
    print(f"  Pages: {original_pages} -> {len(final_reader.pages)}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        date_str = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
        add_cover_page()
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - surface any failure clearly
        print(f"ERROR: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

"""Prepend a cover page to report.pdf with title 'Annual Financial Report'
and the operator runtime current date. Only touches report.pdf."""
import datetime
import os
import tempfile

from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.lib.styles import getSampleStyleSheet, ParagraphStyle
from reportlab.lib.units import inch
from reportlab.platypus import SimpleDocTemplate, Paragraph, Spacer
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

INPUT = "report.pdf"
OUTPUT = "report.pdf"


def main():
    if not os.path.exists(INPUT):
        raise SystemExit(f"missing input file: {INPUT}")

    # Operator runtime current date
    now = datetime.date.today()
    date_str = now.strftime("%B %d, %Y")

    # Build the cover page PDF in a temp file
    tmp_fd, tmp_cover = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=".pdf", prefix="cover_", dir=".")
    os.close(tmp_fd)
    try:
        doc = SimpleDocTemplate(tmp_cover, pagesize=letter)
        styles = getSampleStyleSheet()
        title_style = ParagraphStyle(
            "CoverTitle", parent=styles["Title"], fontSize=28, leading=34, alignment=1
        )
        date_style = ParagraphStyle(
            "CoverDate", parent=styles["Normal"], fontSize=16, leading=22, alignment=1
        )
        story = [
            Spacer(1, 3.5 * inch),
            Paragraph("Annual Financial Report", title_style),
            Spacer(1, 0.6 * inch),
            Paragraph(date_str, date_style),
        ]
        doc.build(story)

        # Merge cover page in front of the existing report pages
        reader = PdfReader(INPUT)
        writer = PdfWriter()
        cover_reader = PdfReader(tmp_cover)
        for page in cover_reader.pages:
            writer.add_page(page)
        for page in reader.pages:
            writer.add_page(page)

        # Atomic replace of report.pdf
        tmp_fd2, tmp_out = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=".pdf", prefix="report_new_", dir=".")
        os.close(tmp_fd2)
        try:
            with open(tmp_out, "wb") as fh:
                writer.write(fh)
            os.replace(tmp_out, OUTPUT)
        finally:
            if os.path.exists(tmp_out):
                os.remove(tmp_out)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(tmp_cover):
            os.remove(tmp_cover)

    print(
        f"OK: cover page prepended to {OUTPUT} "
        f"(total pages: {len(reader.pages) + 1}, date: {date_str})"
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def read_object(data, offset):
    """Return raw bytes of the object starting at offset (through 'endobj')."""
    end = data.find(b"endobj", offset)
    if end == -1:
        raise ValueError(f"'endobj' not found at offset {offset}")
    return data[offset:end + len(b"endobj")]


def parse_xref_table(data, offset):
    """Parse a classic xref table -> {objnum: (offset, generation, in_use)}."""
    if data[offset:offset + 4] != b"xref":
        raise ValueError(f"expected 'xref' at offset {offset}, got {data[offset:offset + 12]!r}")
    pos = offset + 4
    entries = {}
    while pos < len(data):
        while pos < len(data) and data[pos] in b" \t\r\n":
            pos += 1
        m = re.match(rb"(\d+)\s+(\d+)", data[pos:pos + 32])
        if not m:
            break
        first, count = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2))
        pos += m.end()
        for i in range(count):
            line = data[pos:pos + 20]
            if len(line) < 19:
                raise ValueError("truncated xref entry")
            off = int(line[0:10])
            gen = int(line[11:16])
            used = line[17:18] == b"n"
            entries[first + i] = (off, gen, used)
            if line[18:20] == b"\r\n":
                pos += 20
            elif line[18:19] == b"\n":
                pos += 19
            else:
                pos += 20
    return entries


def parse_trailer(data, start):
    """Parse the trailer dictionary after an xref table (best effort)."""
    t = data.find(b"trailer", start)
    if t == -1:
        return {}
    d = data.find(b"<<", t)
    if d == -1:
        return {}
    seg = data[d:d + 8192]
    info = {}
    m = re.search(rb"/Root\s+(\d+)\s+\d+\s+R", seg)
    if m:
        info["root"] = int(m.group(1))
    m = re.search(rb"/Size\s+(\d+)", seg)
    if m:
        info["size"] = int(m.group(1))
    m = re.search(rb"/Prev\s+(\d+)", seg)
    if m:
        info["prev"] = int(m.group(1))
    m = re.search(rb"/Info\s+(\d+)\s+\d+\s+R", seg)
    if m:
        info["info"] = int(m.group(1))
    m = re.search(rb"/ID\s*\[(.*?)\]", seg, re.S)
    if m:
        info["id"] = m.group(1).strip()
    return info


def load_xref(data):
    """Load the live xref map (following /Prev chains) and the latest trailer."""
    matches = list(re.finditer(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data))
    if not matches:
        raise ValueError("no 'startxref' found")
    offset = int(matches[-1].group(1))
    chain = []
    seen = set()
    while offset and offset not in seen:
        seen.add(offset)
        table = parse_xref_table(data, offset)
        trailer = parse_trailer(data, offset)
        chain.append((table, trailer))
        offset = trailer.get("prev", 0)
    if not chain:
        raise ValueError("no xref table found")
    xref = {}
    for table, _ in reversed(chain):  # oldest -> newest so newest wins
        for num, val in table.items():
            xref[num] = val
    return xref, chain[0][1]

    m = re.search(rb"/" + key + rb"\s+(\d+)\s+\d+\s+R", raw)
    return int(m.group(1)) if m else None


def extract_kids(raw):
    m = re.search(rb"/Kids\s*\[(.*?)\]", raw, re.S)
    if not m:
        return None
    return [int(x) for x in re.findall(rb"(\d+)\s+\d+\s+R", m.group(1))]


def extract_count(raw):
    m = re.search(rb"/Count\s+(\d+)", raw)
    return int(m.group(1)) if m else None

def build_cover_objects(next_num, pages_ref, title, date_text):
    content = build_cover_content(title, date_text)
    content_num = next_num
    bold_num = next_num + 1
    reg_num = next_num + 2
    page_num = next_num + 3
    objs = [

def assemble(data, xref, trailer, modified_pages, new_objects, new_root):
    """Rebuild the PDF: original bytes kept, new objects appended, new xref/trailer."""
    offsets = {num: [off, gen, used] for num, (off, gen, used) in xref.items()}
    chunks = [data]
    pos = len(data)

    def append(raw):
        nonlocal pos
        chunks.append(b"\n")
        pos += 1
        chunks.append(raw)
        pos += len(raw)

    if modified_pages is not None:
        num, raw = modified_pages
        offsets[num] = [pos, 0, True]
        append(raw)
    for num, raw in new_objects:
        offsets[num] = [pos, 0, True]
        append(raw)

    body = b"".join(chunks)
    out = bytearray(body)
    xref_pos = len(out)
    max_num = max(offsets) if offsets else 0
    size = max(trailer.get("size", 0), max_num + 1)
    out += b"xref\n0 %d\n" % size
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f\r\n"
    for num in range(1, size):
        if num in offsets:
            off, gen, used = offsets[num]
            flag = b"n" if used else b"f"
            out += b"%010d %05d %s\r\n" % (off, gen, flag)
        else:
            out += b"0000000000 65535 f\r\n"
    root = new_root if new_root is not None else trailer.get("root")
    if root is None:
        raise ValueError("no /Root in trailer")
    out += b"trailer\n<< /Size %d /Root %d 0 R" % (size, root)
    if trailer.get("info"):
        out += b" /Info %d 0 R" % trailer["info"]
    if trailer.get("id"):
        out += b" /ID [%s]" % trailer["id"]
    out += b" >>\nstartxref\n%d\n%%%%EOF\n" % xref_pos
    return bytes(out)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def main():
    if not os.path.exists(REPORT_PATH):
        raise SystemExit(f"missing input: {REPORT_PATH}")
    with open(REPORT_PATH, "rb") as fh:
        data = fh.read()
    if not data.startswith(b"%PDF"):
        raise SystemExit(f"{REPORT_PATH} does not look like a PDF file")

    xref, trailer = load_xref(data)
    root = trailer.get("root")
    if root is None or root not in xref:
        raise SystemExit("could not locate document catalog (/Root) in trailer")
    cat_raw = read_object(data, xref[root][0])
    pages_num = extract_ref(cat_raw, b"Pages")
    if pages_num is None or pages_num not in xref:
        raise SystemExit("could not locate page tree (/Pages) in catalog")
    pages_raw = read_object(data, xref[pages_num][0])
    mtype = re.search(rb"/Type\s*/(\w+)", pages_raw)
    ptype = mtype.group(1) if mtype else b""
    kids = extract_kids(pages_raw)
    count = extract_count(pages_raw)

    date_text = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    next_num = max(xref) + 1

    if kids is not None:
        original_count = count if count is not None else len(kids)
        cover_objs, cover_num, next_num = build_cover_objects(
            next_num, pages_num, TITLE, date_text)
        m = re.search(rb"/Kids\s*\[(.*?)\]", pages_raw, re.S)
        new_kids = b" ".join(b"%d 0 R" % n for n in [cover_num] + kids)
        new_pages_raw = pages_raw[:m.start(1)] + new_kids + pages_raw[m.end(1):]
        mc = re.search(rb"/Count\s+(\d+)", new_pages_raw)
        if mc:
            new_pages_raw = (new_pages_raw[:mc.start(1)]
                             + str(original_count + 1).encode()
                             + new_pages_raw[mc.end(1):])
        else:
            idx = new_pages_raw.rfind(b">>")
            if idx == -1:
                raise SystemExit("page-tree node has no closing '>>'")
            new_pages_raw = (new_pages_raw[:idx]
                             + b" /Count %d" % (original_count + 1)
                             + new_pages_raw[idx:])
        modified_pages = (pages_num, new_pages_raw)
        new_objects = cover_objs
        new_root = None
        expected = original_count + 1
    elif ptype == b"Page":
        # Single-page document whose catalog /Pages points directly at the page.
        new_pages_num = next_num
        next_num += 1
        new_cat_num = next_num
        next_num += 1
        cover_objs, cover_num, next_num = build_cover_objects(
            next_num, new_pages_num, TITLE, date_text)
        new_pages_obj = (b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [%d 0 R %d 0 R] /Count 2 >>"
                         % (cover_num, pages_num))
        cat_new = re.sub(rb"(/Pages\s+)(\d+)(\s+\d+\s+R)",
                         rb"\g<1>%d\g<3>" % new_pages_num, cat_raw, count=1)
        new_objects = [(new_pages_num, new_pages_obj),
                       (new_cat_num, cat_new)] + cover_objs
        modified_pages = None
        new_root = new_cat_num
        expected = 2
    else:
        raise SystemExit("unexpected page-tree structure (no /Kids and not /Page)")

    orig_mode = stat.S_IMODE(os.stat(REPORT_PATH).st_mode)
    fd, tmp_path = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=".", prefix=".report_cover_", suffix=".pdf")
    os.close(fd)
    try:
        out_bytes = assemble(data, xref, trailer, modified_pages, new_objects, new_root)
        with open(tmp_path, "wb") as fh:
            fh.write(out_bytes)
        os.replace(tmp_path, REPORT_PATH)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(tmp_path):
            os.unlink(tmp_path)
    os.chmod(REPORT_PATH, orig_mode)

    # --- Structural validation of the transformed file ---
    with open(REPORT_PATH, "rb") as fh:
        vdata = fh.read()
    vxref, vtrailer = load_xref(vdata)
    vroot = vtrailer.get("root")
    if vroot is None or vroot not in vxref:
        raise SystemExit("validation failed: /Root not found after transform")
    vcat = read_object(vdata, vxref[vroot][0])
    vpages_num = extract_ref(vcat, b"Pages")
    vpages_raw = read_object(vdata, vxref[vpages_num][0])
    vkids = extract_kids(vpages_raw)
    vcount = extract_count(vpages_raw)
    if vkids is None or vcount != expected:
        raise SystemExit(f"validation failed: page count {vcount}, kids {vkids}, expected {expected}")
    vcover_num = vkids[0]
    if vcover_num not in vxref:
        raise SystemExit("validation failed: cover page object not in xref")
    vcover_raw = read_object(vdata, vxref[vcover_num][0])
    vcontent_num = extract_ref(vcover_raw, b"Contents")
    if vcontent_num is None or vcontent_num not in vxref:
        raise SystemExit("validation failed: cover content stream missing")
    vcontent_raw = read_object(vdata, vxref[vcontent_num][0])
    if TITLE.encode("latin-1") not in vcontent_raw:
        raise SystemExit("validation failed: cover title not found on page 1")
    if date_text.encode("latin-1") not in vcontent_raw:
        raise SystemExit("validation failed: cover date not found on page 1")

    print(f"OK: prepended cover page to {REPORT_PATH}")
    print(f"Pages: {expected - 1} -> {expected}")
    print(f"Cover title: {TITLE}")
    print(f"Cover date: {date_text}")

and the operator runtime current date, then validate the result.

1. Parse report.pdf's classic xref table(s) and trailer (/Root, /Size, /Prev chain).
2. Locate the catalog and the root page-tree node (/Kids, /Count); scan objects
   if the trailer path does not resolve (self-diagnosing).
3. Build new objects (cover page, its content stream, two standard-14 fonts)
   and insert the cover page as the first kid of the page tree.
4. Rewrite the file: original bytes kept verbatim, new objects appended,
   fresh xref + trailer written at the end.
5. Re-parse the result to validate page count and cover text.

def _pdf_escape(text):
    return text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def build_cover_content(title, date_text):
    """Return the page content stream (bytes) for the letter-size cover page."""
    def string_width(text, table, size):
        return sum(table.get(ch, 556) for ch in text) / 1000.0 * size

    title_w = string_width(title, HELV_BOLD, 28)
    date_w = string_width(date_text, HELV, 16)

        "BT\n/F1 28 Tf\n0 0 0 rg\n"

    ).encode("latin-1")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PDF structure parsing (classic xref tables only)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def read_object(data, offset):
    """Return raw bytes of the object starting at offset (through 'endobj')."""
    end = data.find(b"endobj", offset)
    if end == -1:
        raise ValueError(f"'endobj' not found at offset {offset}")
    return data[offset:end + len(b"endobj")]


def parse_xref_table(data, offset):
    """Parse a classic xref table -> {objnum: (offset, generation, in_use)}."""
    if data[offset:offset + 4] != b"xref":
        raise ValueError(f"expected 'xref' at offset {offset}, got {data[offset:offset + 12]!r}")
    pos = offset + 4
    entries = {}
    while pos < len(data):
        while pos < len(data) and data[pos] in b" \t\r\n":
            pos += 1
        m = re.match(rb"(\d+)\s+(\d+)", data[pos:pos + 32])
        if not m:
            break
        first, count = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2))
        pos += m.end()
        for i in range(count):
            line = data[pos:pos + 20]
            if len(line) < 19:
                raise ValueError("truncated xref entry")
            off = int(line[0:10])
            gen = int(line[11:16])
            used = line[17:18] == b"n"
            entries[first + i] = (off, gen, used)
            if line[18:20] == b"\r\n":
                pos += 20
            elif line[18:19] == b"\n":
                pos += 19
            else:
                pos += 20
    return entries


def parse_trailer(data, start):
    """Parse the trailer dictionary after an xref table (best effort)."""
    t = data.find(b"trailer", start)
    if t == -1:
        return {}
    d = data.find(b"<<", t)
    if d == -1:
        return {}
    seg = data[d:d + 8192]
    info = {}
    m = re.search(rb"/Root\s+(\d+)\s+\d+\s+R", seg)
    if m:
        info["root"] = int(m.group(1))
    m = re.search(rb"/Size\s+(\d+)", seg)
    if m:
        info["size"] = int(m.group(1))
    m = re.search(rb"/Prev\s+(\d+)", seg)
    if m:
        info["prev"] = int(m.group(1))
    m = re.search(rb"/Info\s+(\d+)\s+\d+\s+R", seg)
    if m:
        info["info"] = int(m.group(1))
    m = re.search(rb"/ID\s*\[(.*?)\]", seg, re.S)
    if m:
        info["id"] = m.group(1).strip()
    return info


def load_xref(data):
    """Load the live xref map (following /Prev chains) and the latest trailer."""
    matches = list(re.finditer(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data))
    if not matches:
        raise ValueError("no 'startxref' found")
    offset = int(matches[-1].group(1))
    chain = []
    seen = set()
    while offset and offset not in seen:
        seen.add(offset)
        table = parse_xref_table(data, offset)
        trailer = parse_trailer(data, offset)
        chain.append((table, trailer))
        offset = trailer.get("prev", 0)
    if not chain:
        raise ValueError("no xref table found")
    xref = {}
    for table, _ in reversed(chain):  # oldest -> newest so newest wins
        for num, val in table.items():
            xref[num] = val
    return xref, chain[0][1]


def extract_ref(raw, key):
    m = re.search(rb"/" + key + rb"\s+(\d+)\s+\d+\s+R", raw)
    return int(m.group(1)) if m else None


def extract_kids(raw):
    m = re.search(rb"/Kids\s*\[(.*?)\]", raw, re.S)
    if not m:
        return None
    return [int(x) for x in re.findall(rb"(\d+)\s+\d+\s+R", m.group(1))]


def extract_count(raw):
    m = re.search(rb"/Count\s+(\d+)", raw)
    return int(m.group(1)) if m else None


def locate_catalog_and_pages(data, xref, trailer):
    """Return (catalog_raw, pages_num). Falls back to scanning objects."""
    diagnostics = []
    root = trailer.get("root")
    if root is not None:
        diagnostics.append(f"trailer /Root = {root}, /Size = {trailer.get('size')}, "
                           f"/Prev = {trailer.get('prev')}")
        if root in xref:
            off = xref[root][0]
            raw = read_object(data, off)
            diagnostics.append(f"object {root} at {off} starts: {raw[:160]!r}")
            pages_num = extract_ref(raw, b"Pages")
            if pages_num is not None and pages_num in xref:
                return raw, pages_num
            diagnostics.append(f"no /Pages ref found in object {root}")
        else:
            diagnostics.append(f"root {root} not present in xref")
    else:
        diagnostics.append("no /Root in trailer")

    # Fallback: scan every live object for a catalog with a /Pages reference.
    for num in sorted(xref):
        off, gen, used = xref[num]
        if not used:
            continue
        try:
            raw = read_object(data, off)
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            continue
        if b"/Type /Catalog" in raw:
            pages_num = extract_ref(raw, b"Pages")
            if pages_num is not None and pages_num in xref:
                diagnostics.append(f"scanned catalog found: object {num} -> /Pages {pages_num}")
                return raw, pages_num
    raise SystemExit("could not locate page tree (/Pages).\n" + "\n".join(diagnostics))


def locate_pages_node(data, xref, pages_num, diagnostics):
    """Return (pages_raw, kids, count, ptype) for the given pages node."""
    if pages_num not in xref:
        raise SystemExit(f"/Pages {pages_num} not present in xref.\n" + "\n".join(diagnostics))
    raw = read_object(data, xref[pages_num][0])
    mtype = re.search(rb"/Type\s*/(\w+)", raw)
    ptype = mtype.group(1) if mtype else b""
    kids = extract_kids(raw)
    count = extract_count(raw)
    diagnostics.append(f"pages node {pages_num} type={ptype.decode(errors='replace')} "
                       f"kids={kids} count={count}")
    return raw, kids, count, ptype

def build_cover_objects(next_num, pages_ref, title, date_text):

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# File assembly
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def assemble(data, xref, trailer, modified_pages, new_objects, new_root):
    """Rebuild the PDF: original bytes kept, new objects appended, new xref/trailer."""
    offsets = {num: [off, gen, used] for num, (off, gen, used) in xref.items()}
    chunks = [data]
    pos = len(data)

    def append(raw):
        nonlocal pos
        chunks.append(b"\n")
        pos += 1
        chunks.append(raw)
        pos += len(raw)

    if modified_pages is not None:
        num, raw = modified_pages
        offsets[num] = [pos, 0, True]
        append(raw)
    for num, raw in new_objects:
        offsets[num] = [pos, 0, True]
        append(raw)

    body = b"".join(chunks)
    out = bytearray(body)
    xref_pos = len(out)
    max_num = max(offsets) if offsets else 0
    size = max(trailer.get("size", 0), max_num + 1)
    out += b"xref\n0 %d\n" % size
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f\r\n"
    for num in range(1, size):
        if num in offsets:
            off, gen, used = offsets[num]
            flag = b"n" if used else b"f"
            out += b"%010d %05d %s\r\n" % (off, gen, flag)
        else:
            out += b"0000000000 65535 f\r\n"
    root = new_root if new_root is not None else trailer.get("root")
    if root is None:
        raise ValueError("no /Root in trailer")
    out += b"trailer\n<< /Size %d /Root %d 0 R" % (size, root)
    if trailer.get("info"):
        out += b" /Info %d 0 R" % trailer["info"]
    if trailer.get("id"):
        out += b" /ID [%s]" % trailer["id"]
    out += b" >>\nstartxref\n%d\n%%%%EOF\n" % xref_pos
    return bytes(out)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Prepend a cover page to report.pdf with the exact title 'Annual Financial Report'
and the operator runtime current date, then validate the result.

Pure-stdlib implementation (no third-party PDF libraries required):
1. Parse report.pdf's classic xref table(s) and trailer (/Root, /Size, /Prev chain).
2. Locate the catalog and the root page-tree node (/Kids, /Count); scan objects
   if the trailer path does not resolve (self-diagnosing).
3. Build new objects (cover page, its content stream, two standard-14 fonts)
   and insert the cover page as the first kid of the page tree.
4. Rewrite the file: original bytes kept verbatim, new objects appended,
   fresh xref + trailer written at the end.
5. Re-parse the result to validate page count and cover text.
"""

import datetime
import os
import re
import stat
import sys
import tempfile

TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"
REPORT_PATH = "report.pdf"
PAGE_W = 612.0
PAGE_H = 792.0

# Helvetica metrics (units per 1000 em) for characters used by title/date.
HELV = {

    "0": 556, "1": 556, "2": 556, "3": 556, "4": 556,
