    "A": 667, "B": 667, "C": 722, "D": 722, "E": 667, "F": 611, "G": 778, "H": 722,
    "I": 278, "J": 500, "K": 667, "L": 556, "M": 833, "N": 722, "O": 778, "P": 667,
    "Q": 778, "R": 722, "S": 667, "T": 611, "U": 722, "V": 667, "W": 944, "X": 667,
    "Y": 667, "Z": 611,
    "a": 556, "b": 556, "c": 500, "d": 556, "e": 556, "f": 278, "g": 556, "h": 556,
    "i": 222, "j": 222, "k": 500, "l": 222, "m": 833, "n": 556, "o": 556, "p": 556,
    "q": 556, "r": 333, "s": 500, "t": 278, "u": 556, "v": 500, "w": 722, "x": 500,
    "y": 500, "z": 500,
}
HELV_BOLD = {
    " ": 278, ",": 278, ".": 278,
    "0": 556, "1": 556, "2": 556, "3": 556, "4": 556,
    "5": 556, "6": 556, "7": 556, "8": 556, "9": 556,
    "A": 722, "B": 722, "C": 722, "D": 722, "E": 667, "F": 611, "G": 778, "H": 722,
    "I": 278, "J": 556, "K": 722, "L": 611, "M": 833, "N": 722, "O": 778, "P": 667,
    "Q": 778, "R": 722, "S": 667, "T": 611, "U": 722, "V": 667, "W": 944, "X": 667,
    "Y": 667, "Z": 611,
    "a": 556, "b": 611, "c": 556, "d": 611, "e": 556, "f": 333, "g": 611, "h": 611,
    "i": 278, "j": 278, "k": 556, "l": 278, "m": 889, "n": 611, "o": 611, "p": 611,
    "q": 611, "r": 389, "s": 556, "t": 333, "u": 611, "v": 556, "w": 778, "x": 556,
    "y": 556, "z": 500,

def _pdf_escape(text):
    return text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def build_cover_content(title, date_text):
    """Return the page content stream (bytes) for the letter-size cover page."""
    def string_width(text, table, size):
        return sum(table.get(ch, 556) for ch in text) / 1000.0 * size

    title_w = string_width(title, HELV_BOLD, 28)
    date_w = string_width(date_text, HELV, 16)
    title_x = (PAGE_W - title_w) / 2.0
    date_x = (PAGE_W - date_w) / 2.0

    return (
        "BT\n/F1 28 Tf\n0 0 0 rg\n"
        f"{title_x:.2f} 460.00 Td\n({_pdf_escape(title)}) Tj\nET\n"
        "BT\n/F2 16 Tf\n0 0 0 rg\n"
        f"{date_x:.2f} 420.00 Td\n({_pdf_escape(date_text)}) Tj\nET\n"
    ).encode("latin-1")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PDF structure parsing (classic xref tables only)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def read_object(data, offset):
    """Return raw bytes of the object starting at offset (through 'endobj')."""
    end = data.find(b"endobj", offset)
    if end == -1:
        raise ValueError(f"'endobj' not found at offset {offset}")
    return data[offset:end + len(b"endobj")]


def parse_xref_table(data, offset):
    """Parse a classic xref table -> {objnum: (offset, generation, in_use)}."""
    if data[offset:offset + 4] != b"xref":
        raise ValueError(f"expected 'xref' at offset {offset}, got {data[offset:offset + 12]!r}")
    pos = offset + 4
    entries = {}
    while pos < len(data):
        while pos < len(data) and data[pos] in b" \t\r\n":
            pos += 1
        m = re.match(rb"(\d+)\s+(\d+)", data[pos:pos + 32])
        if not m:
            break
        first, count = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2))
        pos += m.end()
        for i in range(count):
            line = data[pos:pos + 20]
            if len(line) < 19:
                raise ValueError("truncated xref entry")
            off = int(line[0:10])
            gen = int(line[11:16])
            used = line[17:18] == b"n"
            entries[first + i] = (off, gen, used)
            if line[18:20] == b"\r\n":
                pos += 20
            elif line[18:19] == b"\n":
                pos += 19
            else:
                pos += 20
    return entries


def parse_trailer(data, start):
    """Parse the trailer dictionary after an xref table (best effort)."""
    t = data.find(b"trailer", start)
    if t == -1:
        return {}
    d = data.find(b"<<", t)
    if d == -1:
        return {}
    seg = data[d:d + 8192]
    info = {}
    m = re.search(rb"/Root\s+(\d+)\s+\d+\s+R", seg)
    if m:
        info["root"] = int(m.group(1))
    m = re.search(rb"/Size\s+(\d+)", seg)
    if m:
        info["size"] = int(m.group(1))
    m = re.search(rb"/Prev\s+(\d+)", seg)
    if m:
        info["prev"] = int(m.group(1))
    m = re.search(rb"/Info\s+(\d+)\s+\d+\s+R", seg)
    if m:
        info["info"] = int(m.group(1))
    m = re.search(rb"/ID\s*\[(.*?)\]", seg, re.S)
    if m:
        info["id"] = m.group(1).strip()
    return info


def load_xref(data):
    """Load the live xref map (following /Prev chains) and the latest trailer."""
    matches = list(re.finditer(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data))
    if not matches:
        raise ValueError("no 'startxref' found")
    offset = int(matches[-1].group(1))
    chain = []
    seen = set()
    while offset and offset not in seen:
        seen.add(offset)
        table = parse_xref_table(data, offset)
        trailer = parse_trailer(data, offset)
        chain.append((table, trailer))
        offset = trailer.get("prev", 0)
    if not chain:
        raise ValueError("no xref table found")
    xref = {}
    for table, _ in reversed(chain):  # oldest -> newest so newest wins
        for num, val in table.items():
            xref[num] = val
    return xref, chain[0][1]


def extract_ref(raw, key):
    m = re.search(rb"/" + key + rb"\s+(\d+)\s+\d+\s+R", raw)
    return int(m.group(1)) if m else None


def extract_kids(raw):
    m = re.search(rb"/Kids\s*\[(.*?)\]", raw, re.S)
    if not m:
        return None
    return [int(x) for x in re.findall(rb"(\d+)\s+\d+\s+R", m.group(1))]


def extract_count(raw):
    m = re.search(rb"/Count\s+(\d+)", raw)
    return int(m.group(1)) if m else None


def locate_catalog_and_pages(data, xref, trailer, diagnostics):
    """Return (catalog_raw, pages_num). Falls back to scanning objects."""
    root = trailer.get("root")
    if root is not None:
        diagnostics.append(f"trailer /Root = {root}, /Size = {trailer.get('size')}, "
                           f"/Prev = {trailer.get('prev')}")
        if root in xref:
            off = xref[root][0]
            raw = read_object(data, off)
            diagnostics.append(f"object {root} at {off} starts: {raw[:160]!r}")
            pages_num = extract_ref(raw, b"Pages")
            if pages_num is not None and pages_num in xref:
                return raw, pages_num
            diagnostics.append(f"no /Pages ref found in object {root}")
        else:
            diagnostics.append(f"root {root} not present in xref")
    else:
        diagnostics.append("no /Root in trailer")

    # Fallback: scan every live object for a catalog with a /Pages reference.
    for num in sorted(xref):
        off, gen, used = xref[num]
        if not used:
            continue
        try:
            raw = read_object(data, off)
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            continue
        if b"/Type /Catalog" in raw:
            pages_num = extract_ref(raw, b"Pages")
            if pages_num is not None and pages_num in xref:
                diagnostics.append(f"scanned catalog found: object {num} -> /Pages {pages_num}")
                return raw, pages_num
    raise SystemExit("could not locate page tree (/Pages).\n" + "\n".join(diagnostics))


def locate_pages_node(data, xref, pages_num, diagnostics):
    """Return (pages_raw, kids, count, ptype) for the given pages node."""
    if pages_num not in xref:
        raise SystemExit(f"/Pages {pages_num} not present in xref.\n" + "\n".join(diagnostics))
    raw = read_object(data, xref[pages_num][0])
    mtype = re.search(rb"/Type\s*/(\w+)", raw)
    ptype = mtype.group(1) if mtype else b""
    kids = extract_kids(raw)
    count = extract_count(raw)
    diagnostics.append(f"pages node {pages_num} type={ptype.decode(errors='replace')} "
                       f"kids={kids} count={count}")
    return raw, kids, count, ptype


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# New cover-page objects
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def build_cover_objects(next_num, pages_ref, title, date_text):
    content = build_cover_content(title, date_text)
    content_num = next_num
    bold_num = next_num + 1
    reg_num = next_num + 2
    page_num = next_num + 3
    objs = [
        (content_num,
         b"<< /Length %d >>\nstream\n" % len(content) + content + b"\nendstream"),
        (bold_num, b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold >>"),
        (reg_num, b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>"),
        (page_num,
         b"<< /Type /Page /Parent %d 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] "
         b"/Resources << /Font << /F1 %d 0 R /F2 %d 0 R >> >> /Contents %d 0 R >>"
         % (pages_ref, bold_num, reg_num, content_num)),
    ]
    return objs, page_num, next_num + 4


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# File assembly
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def assemble(data, xref, trailer, modified_pages, new_objects, new_root):
    """Rebuild the PDF: original bytes kept, new objects appended, new xref/trailer."""
    offsets = {num: [off, gen, used] for num, (off, gen, used) in xref.items()}
    chunks = [data]
    pos = len(data)

    def append(raw):
        nonlocal pos
        chunks.append(b"\n")
        pos += 1
        chunks.append(raw)
        pos += len(raw)

    if modified_pages is not None:
        num, raw = modified_pages
        offsets[num] = [pos, 0, True]
        append(raw)
    for num, raw in new_objects:
        offsets[num] = [pos, 0, True]
        append(raw)

    body = b"".join(chunks)
    out = bytearray(body)
    xref_pos = len(out)
    max_num = max(offsets) if offsets else 0
    size = max(trailer.get("size", 0), max_num + 1)
    out += b"xref\n0 %d\n" % size
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f\r\n"
    for num in range(1, size):
        if num in offsets:
            off, gen, used = offsets[num]
            flag = b"n" if used else b"f"
            out += b"%010d %05d %s\r\n" % (off, gen, flag)
        else:
            out += b"0000000000 65535 f\r\n"
    root = new_root if new_root is not None else trailer.get("root")
    if root is None:
        raise ValueError("no /Root in trailer")
    out += b"trailer\n<< /Size %d /Root %d 0 R" % (size, root)
    if trailer.get("info"):
        out += b" /Info %d 0 R" % trailer["info"]
    if trailer.get("id"):
        out += b" /ID [%s]" % trailer["id"]
    out += b" >>\nstartxref\n%d\n%%%%EOF\n" % xref_pos
    return bytes(out)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def main():
    if not os.path.exists(REPORT_PATH):
        raise SystemExit(f"missing input: {REPORT_PATH}")
    with open(REPORT_PATH, "rb") as fh:
        data = fh.read()
    if not data.startswith(b"%PDF"):
        raise SystemExit(f"{REPORT_PATH} does not look like a PDF file")

    xref, trailer = load_xref(data)
    diagnostics = []
    cat_raw, pages_num = locate_catalog_and_pages(data, xref, trailer, diagnostics)
    pages_raw, kids, count, ptype = locate_pages_node(data, xref, pages_num, diagnostics)

    date_text = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    next_num = max(xref) + 1

    if kids is not None:
        original_count = count if count is not None else len(kids)
        cover_objs, cover_num, next_num = build_cover_objects(
            next_num, pages_num, TITLE, date_text)
        m = re.search(rb"/Kids\s*\[(.*?)\]", pages_raw, re.S)
        new_kids = b" ".join(b"%d 0 R" % n for n in [cover_num] + kids)
        new_pages_raw = pages_raw[:m.start(1)] + new_kids + pages_raw[m.end(1):]
        mc = re.search(rb"/Count\s+(\d+)", new_pages_raw)
        if mc:
            new_pages_raw = (new_pages_raw[:mc.start(1)]
                             + str(original_count + 1).encode()
                             + new_pages_raw[mc.end(1):])
        else:
            idx = new_pages_raw.rfind(b">>")
            if idx == -1:
                raise SystemExit("page-tree node has no closing '>>'")
            new_pages_raw = (new_pages_raw[:idx]
                             + b" /Count %d" % (original_count + 1)
                             + new_pages_raw[idx:])
        modified_pages = (pages_num, new_pages_raw)
        new_objects = cover_objs
        new_root = None
        expected = original_count + 1
    elif ptype == b"Page":
        # Single-page document whose catalog /Pages points directly at the page.
        new_pages_num = next_num
        next_num += 1
        new_cat_num = next_num
        next_num += 1
        cover_objs, cover_num, next_num = build_cover_objects(
            next_num, new_pages_num, TITLE, date_text)
        new_pages_obj = (b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [%d 0 R %d 0 R] /Count 2 >>"
                         % (cover_num, pages_num))
        cat_new = re.sub(rb"(/Pages\s+)(\d+)(\s+\d+\s+R)",
                         rb"\g<1>%d\g<3>" % new_pages_num, cat_raw, count=1)
        new_objects = [(new_pages_num, new_pages_obj),
                       (new_cat_num, cat_new)] + cover_objs
        modified_pages = None
        new_root = new_cat_num
        expected = 2
    else:
        raise SystemExit("unexpected page-tree structure (no /Kids and not /Page)\n"
                         + "\n".join(diagnostics))

    orig_mode = stat.S_IMODE(os.stat(REPORT_PATH).st_mode)
    fd, tmp_path = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=".", prefix=".report_cover_", suffix=".pdf")
    os.close(fd)
    try:
        out_bytes = assemble(data, xref, trailer, modified_pages, new_objects, new_root)
        with open(tmp_path, "wb") as fh:
            fh.write(out_bytes)
        os.replace(tmp_path, REPORT_PATH)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(tmp_path):
            os.unlink(tmp_path)
    os.chmod(REPORT_PATH, orig_mode)

    # --- Structural validation of the transformed file ---
    with open(REPORT_PATH, "rb") as fh:
        vdata = fh.read()
    vxref, vtrailer = load_xref(vdata)
    vroot = vtrailer.get("root")
    if vroot is None or vroot not in vxref:
        raise SystemExit("validation failed: /Root not found after transform")
    vcat = read_object(vdata, vxref[vroot][0])
    vpages_num = extract_ref(vcat, b"Pages")
    vpages_raw = read_object(vdata, vxref[vpages_num][0])
    vkids = extract_kids(vpages_raw)
    vcount = extract_count(vpages_raw)
    if vkids is None or vcount != expected:
        raise SystemExit(f"validation failed: page count {vcount}, kids {vkids}, expected {expected}")
    vcover_num = vkids[0]
    if vcover_num not in vxref:
        raise SystemExit("validation failed: cover page object not in xref")
    vcover_raw = read_object(vdata, vxref[vcover_num][0])
    vcontent_num = extract_ref(vcover_raw, b"Contents")
    if vcontent_num is None or vcontent_num not in vxref:
        raise SystemExit("validation failed: cover content stream missing")
    vcontent_raw = read_object(vdata, vxref[vcontent_num][0])
    if TITLE.encode("latin-1") not in vcontent_raw:
        raise SystemExit("validation failed: cover title not found on page 1")
    if date_text.encode("latin-1") not in vcontent_raw:
        raise SystemExit("validation failed: cover date not found on page 1")

    print("structure:", "; ".join(diagnostics))
    print(f"OK: prepended cover page to {REPORT_PATH}")
    print(f"Pages: {expected - 1} -> {expected}")
    print(f"Cover title: {TITLE}")
    print(f"Cover date: {date_text}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
